in_sanskrit.name: पद्मजा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Padmaja is derived from the Sanskrit words 'padma' meaning lotus and 'jā' meaning born. It represents the birth of a child as beautiful and pure as a lotus flower.

in_hindi.name: पद्मजा
in_hindi.long_meaning: Padmaja's Hindi name is 'पत्तारी'. In Hindi, the word 'पद्म' (padma) means lotus and 'जा' (jā) means born. So, the name Padmaja means 'Born of a Lotus'.

in_tamil.name: பத்மஜா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name for Padmaja is 'பத்மஜா'. The meaning of the name is 'Born of the Lotus'. The word 'பத்மம்' (pathamam) in Tamil means lotus and 'ஜோடி' (jodi) means born.

in_telugu.name: పెద్దజా
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu name for Padmaja is 'పెద్దజా'. The meaning of the name is 'Born of a Lotus'. The word 'పెద్దము' (peddamu) in Telugu means lotus and 'జీడి' (jidi) means born.

in_marathi.name: Padmaja
in_marathi.long_meaning: Padmaja हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Padmaja is derived from the Sanskrit word 'padma' which means 'lotus flower'. In Hindu mythology, the lotus flower symbolizes purity, enlightenment, and detachment from material desires. The name Padmaja is also considered a form of the goddess Lakshmi, who is the goddess of prosperity, wealth, and good fortune.
